sections.en:
Since it is known to the people of judgments that the side of
the north is like the right hand and the side of
the south is like the left hand, then the zodiac is the place of
the heart, and the planets are the seats that are like
the spirits. So when a planet is on the zodiac,
its strength is more than when it is in
the line, for the strength of the spirit in the heart is more
than the extremity. And it is permissible that
Kifayat al-Ta'lim says that if a planet is with the sun
in conjunction, or with the moon separating,
although the attribute of elevation in the planet
was present. From him.

Some say that
cazimi is always
benefic, even if
the planet is malefic.
And some say that
the cazimi of a benefic is benefic
and the cazimi of a malefic is malefic.

and the cazimi of a malefic is neither benefic
nor malefic.
And in the heart, it makes it specifically
benefic.

summary.headline: Ranks of Planetary Strength
summary.text: Astrological classification of planetary strengths, listing the five highest-ranking conditions—house, exaltation, rejoicing, cazimi, and body—followed by middle- and lower-ranking dignities and conditions including hayz, halab, fortune, ascendant degree, latitude, apogees, reception, mixture with benefics, and transfer or collection of light. Cazimi is defined as proximity to the Sun within sixteen or seventeen minutes, with Mercury’s cazimi called a second Sun; marginal notes discuss zodiacal strength, combustion, and differing views on whether cazimi is benefic.
